newsitem.title: UK: Core Labs is Scott Pickford bidder - paper.
newsitem.headline: Core Labs is Scott Pickford bidder - paper.

text.p: Houston-based Core Laboratories NV is the mystery counter-bidder for UK engineering and geoscience firm Scott Pickford Plc, a Sunday newspaper reported.
Australia's Aerodata Holdings Ltd in December announced plans to take a 20 percent stake in Scott Pickford.

Aerodata said on Friday that it had obtained about 21.13 percent of shares in Scott Pickford, but the UK company said it had received an approach from a "substantial and credible party" which might lead to an offer for its whole share capital.
The Sunday Times reported that Core Laboratories, which provides high-technology laboratory services to the energy and environmental industries, was the mystery bidder.
Aerodata offered 48p per share in December. Scott Pickford said the undisclosed party's offer, if it were made, was likely to be at a price of around 53p.
The Sunday Times gave no source for its story. No one at Scott Pickford could be reached for comment on Sunday.
In Houston, no one was immediately available to comment on the report.
